description: This is a C# source file defining the FontAnsiEncoding class, which renders a visual representation of ANSI character encoding mappings in a PDF using PDFsharp library. The file includes methods for rendering strings based on ANSI byte values, as well as a data structure listing character details and descriptions.

classes.name: FontAnsiEncoding
classes.description: Represents a snippet that renders a table mapping ANSI byte values to characters in a PDF.

classes.name: AnsiTable
classes.description: Immutable data structure holding details about each ANSI character code, including number, Unicode character, character symbol, and description.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Renders the ANSI encoding table onto a PDF graphics surface, displaying the index, hex, character, Unicode, and description.
